meta.name: seo-strategy
meta.description: Audits and improves organic search performance — technical health, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and the content decisions that determine what can rank. Use this to run an SEO audit, diagnose why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, plan a site's URL and navigation structure, add structured data, or prioritize which SEO fixes are worth doing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断网站搜索排名问题并制定优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有网站但自然搜索流量上不去
copy.tagline_en: Audit your site's organic search and plan fixes to boost rankings.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a website but organic search traffic is flat.

howto.what: Claude 会按固定顺序诊断网站 SEO：先查页面能否被抓取、能否被收录、是否匹配搜索意图、网站有没有排名权重；再检查网站结构、内链、页面速度与移动端；最后给出按严重程度排序的问题清单、证据、修复顺序与预期影响。
howto.when: 当用户要求做 SEO 审计、诊断某些页面排名差或没被收录、规划 URL 和导航结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我给网站做一次 SEO 审计，按严重程度列出问题和修复顺序。
say.note: 会按抓取、收录、意图等顺序检查。

say.text: 为什么我的产品页在谷歌里搜不到？
say.note: 先排查抓取和收录环节。

say.text: 给这个商品页加上 JSON-LD 结构化数据。
say.note: 会按必填字段生成并提醒别标记虚假内容。

howto.what_en: Runs a staged SEO audit: checks crawlability, indexing, intent match, and site authority; then reviews architecture, internal links, speed, and mobile usability; outputs severity-ranked findings with evidence, fix order, and expected impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an SEO audit, diagnoses why pages rank poorly or are deindexed, or plans URL and navigation structure.

say_en.text: Run an SEO audit for my site and list issues by severity with a fix order.
say_en.note: Checks crawling, indexing, and intent in sequence.

say_en.text: Why isn't my product page showing up on Google?
say_en.note: Starts with crawl and index checks.

say_en.text: Add JSON-LD structured data to this product page.
say_en.note: Generates required fields and warns against fake data.
